title: Shooter buttons in OI
summary: A button is just true or false: write getShootButton() and getIndexButton().

steps.title: A button is true or false
steps.say: Holding a button makes it **true**; letting go makes it **false**. A method that answers a yes/no question returns a `boolean`. The controller already knows the answer. You just ask it.

marks.label: true or false, nothing in between
the controller answers: is it held right now?

steps.title: Open OI.java
steps.say: The buttons live in the same class as the sticks. Press **Ctrl+P**, type `OI` and press Enter. Quick Open finds any file by name, so you never have to dig through folders.

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: The first one is the shoot button. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `right bumper is held` and press Enter to jump to it.

target.text: return true while the right bumper is held

waitFor.hint: find right bumper is held with Ctrl+F.

target.text: return true while the right bumper is held

steps.title: Find it
steps.say: Now the index button, just below. Press **Ctrl+F**, type `left bumper is held` and press Enter to jump to it.

target.text: return true while the left bumper is held

waitFor.hint: find left bumper is held with Ctrl+F.

steps.title: Index button
steps.say: Same idea with the other bumper: `return driverController.getLeftBumperButton();`.

target.text: return true while the left bumper is held
